spec.title: UDP Receive Buffer errors by environment
UDP Receive Buffer errors by region

spec.description: Rate of TURN requests rejected for bad credentials. A sustained non-zero value after a coturn_secret rotation or on a host with clock skew means clients cannot authenticate. coturn 4.18+ only.
spec.title: TURN auth credential failures / region

spec.description: UDP requests that reached the 401 branch, responses actually emitted, and responses suppressed by the per-source rate limiter. A gap between requests and responses is the reflection/amplification mitigation doing its job. coturn 4.18+ only.
spec.title: Unauthorized 401 rate / region

spec.description: Share of incoming packets rejected by early validation. Rises under spoofed-source floods and malformed traffic. Suppressed below 1 packet/s total, because at a handful of packets per window the ratio flaps between 0 and 100% and means nothing. coturn 4.18+ only.
spec.title: Packet drop ratio / region

spec.description: STUN Binding requests and errors. Works on every coturn version. Note that stun_binding_response only counts every response from 4.15 onward, so it steps up when a pool is upgraded.
spec.title: STUN binding rate & errors / region

spec.description: Average datagrams returned per recvmmsg syscall. Climbs above 1 as concurrency rises and shows the batched UDP receive path earning its keep. coturn 4.18+ only. Shows a gap rather than a misleading value when there is no traffic in the window.
spec.title: UDP recvmmsg batch size / region

spec.description: Traffic between coturn and the far-side peer, as opposed to the existing client-side throughput panels. A large asymmetry between the two points at one-way media.
spec.title: Peer-side throughput / region
